answer: Simultaneous live test windows stop alias farming. A new alias earns paid work only after passing a 30 minute live test window, where candidates solve fresh tasks at the same clock time, including a cipher decoding task, a lotus sorting task, and a delta measurement task. One operator cannot sit ten seats at once, and identical keystroke timing or matching wrong answers across seats flag the copies for review. A confirmed copy forfeits that epoch pay and stays barred for 14 epochs, while its test seat stays empty for the next window.
